headline: Binance Flips To A 59.3 Million Dollar Intake As Venue Outflow Falls To 177.8 Million
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, fell to a 177.8 million dollar net outflow, 0.0652 percent of custodied value, from a 743.5 million dollar outflow and 0.2736 percent on the prior print. Binance flipped to a 59.3 million dollar intake from a 243.6 million dollar outflow, while Bitfinex sent out 64.5 million dollars, compared with 311.4 million dollars on the prior print, and Gemini took in 28.8 million dollars. A negative print means dollars left the venues where holders can sell, and a positive print means dollars arrived there.
author: jordan
